target_customer: Professional video editors, agencies and post production teams using Adobe Premiere Pro
problem: Editors spend far more time preparing footage than editing it.
business_model: Subscription, $100 per month with team pricing
product_category: AI assistant editor for footage prep

founders.name: Daniel Pearson
prior_employers: Managed growth ad budgets for clients such as Uber, DoorDash and Dropbox
founders.background_notes: YC page does not list employers or education.

founders.name: Zachary Kim
founders.background_notes: Launch post describes 20 plus years of engineering leadership; employers and education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing, transcription and Premiere project roundtrip on large local libraries is moderately hard.

defensibility.rationale: Native app and Premiere integration help, but many AI editing tools exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Adobe could add similar features; no takeover found.

market_need_then: Company says editors spend about three times longer on preparation than editing, and an agency reported saving about 10 hours weekly (company claims, not independent).

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident, imperative copy in editor jargon

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch reportedly went viral in February 2026 per one aggregator

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive compound tied to film framing; evidence of brand pull is thin.

outcome_analysis: Wideframe is a Winter 2026 company building an AI assistant editor for footage preparation with a paid Mac app. Early traction signals include a Product Hunt launch and named testimonials, but funding is unverified and there is no exit. Competition from other AI editors is dense, and the paid only model targets professionals.
notes: Unverified: aggregators report about $500K, labeled pre-seed (March 2026) by one and seed (January 2026) by another; not recorded as a round. Competitor sources are undated comparison pages. No outcome news found. Competitor list left empty: comparison pages found were undated, so nothing dated near the batch could be confirmed (Eddie AI, ChatCut, Capsule appeared undated). Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (VCBacked, 500K pre-seed, March 2026); cross-check search found no press confirmation. Other aggregators label it seed dated January 2026.
